decisions.reason: Although the net price display plugin is close to the firm's extension know-how and improvable through in-house R&D, its disappearance from the website by 2020-2021 suggests limited standalone traction, so we would discontinue it and fold any useful elements into core shop work.

The ERP system interface plugin draws directly on the firm's strongest integration capabilities and supports its move toward broader multichannel commerce, so despite lower recent visibility we would keep it as a strategically important offering.

This price comparison tracking plugin is within the firm's absorptive capacity, but with several similar tracking products and no later website evidence, the most efficient choice is to rationalize the range and withdraw it.

Because this product overlaps heavily with other price comparison tracking plugins and has not remained visibly marketed, we would reallocate resources away from it even though the firm could technically support it.
The firm can learn from and improve this kind of plugin, but the combination of portfolio duplication and weak later visibility makes discontinuation the more commercially sensible decision.

The net price reporting plugin fits the firm's analytics and shop-extension knowledge base, yet as a narrow add-on that was no longer observed on the website, it is more likely to be dropped than maintained as a separate product.
